text:
kai: heads up — quick bring-up of the new gptx-3b-quant on eval-harness showed a weird pattern: overall accuracy +2.3% but holdout A dropped and some holdout examples are showing up in the train shard. i think we have contamination not model magic.
sophia: ah that smells like sampler RNG or shard key bug. which runner/commit did you run?

kai: ran runner v0.9.2 on ci, commit 9f3b2e. dataset prepared with prompt-gen v0.7. We used `--shard-key=hash(prompt)` and the synthetic generator with `--seed=2026` for replica consistency.

omar: can you paste the minimal repro? even a short list of offending prompt IDs is fine.

kai: attaching small excerpt: ```
train shard 3 contains prompt_id: s-00123f, s-00999a, s-00ab3c
holdout shard 7 contains prompt_id: s-00999a, s-00deff
```

jess: wow that's direct duplication. do we have any post-processing that can rewrite prompt ids or canonicalize prompts? prompt-gen used a `normalize()` step that can reorder json keys — could that change hash?

ryan: two hypotheses: (1) generator produced duplicate examples across cohorts because of seq-sampling bug, (2) shard-key computation changed between prepare and runner (e.g., used raw text vs normalized text). both plausible.

kai: i instrumented the runner and found that the runner's shard-key function was using `sha1(normalized_prompt)` in the runtime but CI dataset builder used `sha1(raw_prompt)` due to an earlier refactor. so mismatch -> same prompt canonicalized differently ended up in different shards sometimes — enabling collisions.

eval-bot: alert: metric_biased_holdout >= 1 sample(s) overlap detected. Details: overlap_count=12, overlap_ratio=0.0012.

sophia: nice find. what's the short-term mitigation? can we re-run with canonicalization aligned?

omar: short-term: regenerate shard map using the same normalization as the runner. medium-term: add a fingerprint step during dataset build and add a CI gate that diffs fingerprint sets. I can whip up a `prompt-fence` pre-commit hook that computes `blake2b` fingerprints after normalization and fails on duplicates/overlaps.

jess: +1 for fingerprint gate. also suggest a small change in eval-runner: log `shard_key_source` (raw|normalized) in the run metadata so we can detect mismatches earlier.

ryan: for CI: add a `dataset-compat-check` job that runs on PRs to models/runner/prompt-gen. It should run: (1) build fingerprints with the builder, (2) ask runner docker image to compute fingerprints for dataset.jsonl, (3) compare. If mismatch -> block.

kai: putting quick patch up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/prompt-gen/pull/412 - normalizer now mirrors runner normalizer. also added `--emit-fingerprint <file>` flag to builder.

omar: can we also add a tiny eval-harness test that simulates shard collision? e.g., generate 10k synthetic prompts, force normalized/raw mismatch, assert overlap_count==0 after fix.

jess: agree. metric definition note: we should add a holdout-leakage alert to the dashboard where `holdout_unique / total_holdout < 0.999` triggers a warning. small but catches this class early.

ryan: logging checklist: dataset fingerprint, prompt version, generator seed, shard key version. Add to run metadata as `dataset_fingerprint`, `prompt_version`, `seed`, `shardkey_version`. We'll include that in CI artifact uploads.

kai: re-run quick job after patch: loss curve stable, holdout overlap_count=0. re-open if we see regression in full run. thanks all. :tada:

omar: follow-up todo: add `prompt-fence` to infra-helpers repo, wire to repo-protections for prompt-gen and runner. estimate 2d.

jess: also add a NOTE in onboarding playbook: "run dataset-compat-check before bringing new model traffic". small ops step saves hours.

eval-bot: closed: leak-alert resolved by PR 412. "overlap_count" dropped from 12 -> 0.

kai: closing thread — i'll schedule a postmortem doc with timeline and links to diffs. if anyone wants to add context ping me. "}
